concepts.text: Trả lời: SBI khác rõ rệt với ASI đã được nghiên cứu (E4)

ASI đòi hỏi đào tạo chuyên sâu và tuân thủ fidelity principles: cá nhân hóa, trẻ chủ động, chơi, thử thách vừa sức (E4). Thuật ngữ đúng: 'nguyên tắc bảo đảm thực hiện đúng phương pháp' hoặc cách nói cùng nghĩa (tuân thủ đúng phương pháp); 'nguyên tắc trung thực' là sai
SBI thường do người lớn dẫn dắt, đầu vào cảm giác thụ động, ví dụ xoa bóp, đeo chụp tai, đu đưa thụ động (E4/E5). Thuật ngữ đúng: 'đu đưa thụ động'; 'du lượn' là sai
Các tổng quan trước đây gộp SBI với ASI (E2/E3) - chỉ để báo cáo

review.procedure: Blind: claims shuffled (seed fixed), arm and unit hidden. Each displayed claim is compared by hand with the verbatim cited quotes: concepts it expresses, term_correct (y/n/na), faithful (meaning, scope, certainty kept, nothing added: y/n), contains_known_wrong_content (y/n). First pass is a draft technical review by Claude, labelled as such; the team confirms or overrides every row before judging. Verifier 'supported' or status 'du' is never used as the quality judgment.

rules.note: every arm-B repetition displays each of the two term concepts in a claim with the correct term AND faithful to the cited quotes (dropping the claim is not a fix)
the correct direct answer (first-round c1) is still displayed and faithful
no displayed arm-B claim on the repaired concepts is unfaithful or keeps a wrong term
U2: the wrong efficacy content is never displayed in arm B (a fixed word on wrong content is a failure)
U2: any displayed arm-B claim on the SBI concept is faithful with the correct term

attribution.rule: benefit is shown only if arm B fixes both term concepts in 3/3 repetitions AND arm A in fewer than 3/3; if arm A also fixes 3/3, the guidance shows no measurable benefit and is not accepted

report_only: displayed and acceptable claims per run
K_REVIEWS (first-round c4 is the known A01 wording the v0.5 verifier passes)
ledger per run: started / saved / errors / cost unknown
verifier results on the NEW wording (never reused from the first round)
completeness: judge refuses (exit 2) if a run is missing or any review row is incomplete; a run that ends in system_error stops the batch (results.partial.json)
conclusion_scope: Answers one narrow question on one question (S08) and two known mistranslations; not a general repair-quality result.

decision.all_rules_pass: propose wiring term guidance into the pipeline as its own approved change, then a 4-question run on a fixed version
decision.any_rule_fails: stop this form of repair feedback; no rewording of the guidance on these units; next candidate (scope splitting or self-contained claims) as its own trial
